question: What speech effect occurs when the practitioner engages all mantras and mudrās?
premises: All groups of mantras and mudrās are involved.
He utters in a stammering manner.
inference: Engaging all mantras and mudrās leads the practitioner to stammering utterance.
uncertainties: The exact nuance of durdurapluta is uncertain.
plain_english: He indeed utters all the groups of mantras and mudrās in a stammering way.
